# Caring Friends

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-30 · status **complete** · Budget spent: ~7 searches and 6 page reads used. No statutory CSR data exists since CF is not a company; no official current website was reachable (www.caringfriends.in redirects to a Google Drive sign-in page, suggesting the domain now points to a private document rather than a live public site). Remaining gaps (current-year disbursement, FY-specific project amounts, any open intake) are not publicly disclosed by any reachable source.

Caring Friends is NOT a registered legal entity but an informal, invitation-only donor collective based in Mumbai (Andheri/Sion), co-founded by Ramesh Kacholia and Nimesh Sumati (formally also called the 'Mumbai Group of Friends'), acting as a bridge between vetted grassroots NGOs and a network of individual donors (reported as ~250-600 people over time). It has no bank account, no legal entity, no office, and takes no administrative cut; donor cheques go directly to the supported NGO. As of a 2018 profile it had channelled over Rs 200 crore to 80 organisations across 17 states over 14 years, and an earlier (~2013) account put annual disbursement at about Rs 30 crore; as of 2018 it was not accepting new NGOs, having over 400 on a waiting list. It identifies, vets and visits NGOs itself (does not run an open application process) and its core team makes an initial substantial ('six-figure') donation before broader fundraising begins. It has a US counterpart, Arpan Foundation. No statutory CSR filings exist for it since it is not a company. Partner NGOs and themes identified include education, water, agriculture, women's empowerment, animal welfare and conservation, with named partners such as Maharogi Sewa Samiti, Samaj Pragati Sahayog, Parivaar Education Society, SAMPARC, Snehalaya, MAHAN Trust, Dilasa Sanstha, Helpers of the Handicapped, SGBS Trust/Unnati, Bhagini Nivedita Gramin Vigyan Niketan, Wildlife SOS, and (via a 2018 dam-desiltation project with Amit Chandra Foundation and Tata Trust) Anulom, BJS, Manavlok, Vikasganga and SSM.

Website: http://www.caringfriends.in
